cards.name: Confront
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Units you play this turn enter ready.

Draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: Now is the only moment that matters.

cards.name: Crackshot Corsair
cards.description: When I attack, deal 1 to an enemy unit here.
cards.flavor_text: "Ahoy."

cards.name: Dune Drake
cards.description: When I attack, give me +2 Might if there is a ready enemy unit here.
cards.flavor_text: Dragons hunt not just for food, but for the thrill of it.

cards.name: First Mate
cards.description: When you play me, ready another unit.
cards.flavor_text: "It's a boarding party! Try to have some fun with it."

cards.name: Flurry of Blades
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Deal 1 to all units at battlefields.
cards.flavor_text: "Violence solves everything." -Katarina

cards.name: Mobilize
cards.description: Channel 1 rune exhausted. If you can't, draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: The sound of the trumpets is the first blow struck in battle.

cards.name: Pakaa Cub
cards.description: HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
cards.flavor_text: "Oh it's so cute!" -Common last words

cards.name: Pit Rookie
cards.description: When you play me, buff another friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets +1 Might buff.)
cards.flavor_text: "Is that all you got?"

cards.name: Stormclaw Ursine
cards.description:
TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.)

When you play me, channel 1 rune exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: "The Ursine speak for man, and the wild responds." -Volibear

cards.name: Catalyst of Aeons
cards.description: Channel 2 runes exhausted. If you couldn't channel 2 runes this way, draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: Ages of strife, crystallized into eternity.

cards.name: Cithria of Cloudfield
cards.description: When you play another unit, buff me. (If I don't have a buff, I get a +1 Might buff.)
cards.flavor_text: Every story starts small.

cards.name: Herald of Scales
cards.description: Your Dragons' Energy costs are reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1.
cards.flavor_text: The language of dragons is a magic of its own.

cards.name: Kinkou Monk
cards.description: When you play me, buff two other friendly units. (Each one that doesn't have a buff gets a +1 Might buff.)
cards.flavor_text: A master teaches the same lesson again and again, and learns something new each time.

cards.name: Mountain Drake
cards.flavor_text: After centuries spent trying to understand dragon behavior, researchers can agree on one thing: If you're seeing that behavior up close ... run.

cards.name: Pirate's Haven
cards.description: When you ready a friendly unit, give it +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: It's the best place in the world, until you run out of coin.

cards.name: Spoils of War
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

If an enemy unit has died this turn, this costs 2 less.

Draw 2.
cards.flavor_text: Waste nothing.

cards.name: Unyielding Spirit
cards.description:
REACTION (Play at any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Prevent all spell and ability damage this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Battles are won in the heart before they are won on the field.

cards.name: Wallop
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

As you play this, you may spend a buff as an additional cost. If you do, ignore this spell's cost. Ready a unit.
cards.flavor_text: If smashing doesn't work, just keep smashing.

cards.name: Wildclaw Shaman
cards.description: When you play me, you may spend a buff to buff me and ready me. (If I don't have a buff, I get a +1 Might buff.)
cards.flavor_text: To channel nature's fury, a shaman must endure it.

cards.name: Anivia - Primal
cards.description: When I attack, deal 3 to all enemy units here.
cards.flavor_text: "Do not tempt the blizzard."

cards.name: Carnivorous Snapvine
cards.description: When you play me, choose an enemy unit at a battlefield. We deal damage equal to our Mights to each other.
cards.flavor_text: Gardening is usually a very relaxing hobby.

cards.name: Kraken Hunter
cards.description:
ACCELERATE (You may pay 1 body as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)

ASSAULT (+1 Might while i'm an attacker.)

As you play me, you may spend any number of buffs as an additional cost. Reduce my cost by body for each buff you spend.

cards.name: Lee Sin - Centered
cards.description:
ACCELERATE (You may pay 1 body as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)

Other buffed friendly units at my battlefield have +2 Might.
cards.flavor_text: "Today will be a worthy test."

cards.name: Lee Sin - Centered (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
ACCELERATE (You may pay 1 body as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)

Other buffed friendly units at my battlefield have +2 Might.
cards.flavor_text: "Today will be a worthy test."

cards.name: Mistfall
cards.description: When you buff a friendly unit, you may pay body and exhaust this to ready it.
cards.flavor_text: Thousands of thwarted dreams, ready to be lifted anew.

cards.name: Overt Operation
cards.description:
ACTION (play on your turn or in showdowns.)

For each friendly unit, you may spend its buff to ready it. Then buff all friendly units. (Each one that doesn't have a buff gets a +1 Might buff.)
cards.flavor_text: "We can go deep undercover, sneak in through the back, and end this quietly. Or...."

cards.name: Primal Strength
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Give a unit +7 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: There is savagery inside us all.

cards.name: Qiyana - Victorious
cards.description:
DEFLECT (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)

When I conquer, draw 1 or channel 1 Rune exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: "Line them up. I will bend their knees."

cards.name: Sabotage
cards.description: Choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. Choose a non-unit card from it, and recycle that card.
cards.flavor_text: Sometimes it takes dirty tricks to ensure a fair fight.

cards.name: Udyr - Wildman
cards.description:
Spend my buff: Choose one you've not chosen turn —

•Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield.

•Stun a unit at a battlefield

•Ready me.

•Give me GANKING this turn.

cards.name: Volibear - Imposing
cards.description:
SHIELD 3 (+3 Might while I'm a defender.)

TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.)

When an opponent moves to a battlefield other than mine, draw 1. (Bases are not battlefields.)
cards.flavor_text: "Gods do not beg. We take what is ours!"

cards.name: Volibear - Imposing (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
SHIELD 3 (+3 Might while I'm a defender.)

TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.)

When an opponent moves to a battlefield other than mine, draw 1. (Bases are not battlefields.)
cards.flavor_text: "Gods do not beg. We take what is ours!"

cards.name: Warwick - Hunter
cards.description:
I enter ready.

When I attack, kill all damaged enemy units here.
cards.flavor_text: "The blood you spilled calls to me."

cards.name: Dazzling Aurora
cards.description: At the end of your turn, reveal cards from the top of your Main Deck until you reveal a unit. Play it, ignoring its cost, and recycle the rest.
cards.flavor_text: The omens offer much to those who dare to see them.

cards.name: Deadbloom Predator
cards.description:
DEFLECT (Opponents must play rune to choose me with a spell or effect.)

You may play me to an occupied enemy battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: The souls of those who died unfulfilled coalesce into a form to sate those hungers.

cards.name: Miss Fortune - Captain
cards.description:
ACCELERATE (You may pay 1 body as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)

GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

The first time I move each turn, you may ready something else that's exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: "Set sail!"

cards.name: Miss Fortune - Captain (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
ACCELERATE (You may pay 1 body as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)

GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

The first time I move each turn, you may ready something else that's exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: "Set sail!"

cards.name: Seal of Strength
cards.description: Exhaust: REACTION - ADD body. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

cards.name: Sett - Brawler
cards.description:
When I'm played and when I conquer, buff me. (If I don't have a buff, I get a +1 Might buff.)

Spend my buff: Give me +4 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Momma always said I had her temper."

cards.name: Sett - Brawler (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
When I'm played and when I conquer, buff me. (If I don't have a buff, I get a +1 Might buff.)

Spend my buff: Give me +4 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Momma always said I had her temper."

cards.name: Cemetery Attendant
cards.description: When you play me, return a unit from your trash to your hand.
cards.flavor_text: "Good boy! Now, where's the rest of 'em?"

cards.name: Ember Monk
cards.description: When you play a card from HIDDEN, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: A flame bright enough to cast many shadows.

cards.name: Fight or Flight
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Move a unit from a battlefield to its base.
cards.flavor_text: "Boo."

cards.name: Gust
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Return a unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Morbid Return
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Return a unit from your trash to your hand.
cards.flavor_text: "Soon, this long cruel night will end. But not yet." -Viego

cards.name: Mystic Poro
cards.description: VISION (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
cards.flavor_text: Forecast: Sunny, with a chance of snax.

cards.name: Rebuke
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Return a unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor_text: "Get out."

cards.name: Ride The Wind
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Move a friendly unit and ready it.
cards.flavor_text: "Follow the wind, but watch your back." -Yasuo

cards.name: Sai Scout
cards.description:
VISION (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

You may play me to an open battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Ours for the taking!"

cards.name: Shipyard Skulker
cards.flavor_text: Few people laughed when she claimed she was a "dock pirate" - or at least, few remained.

cards.name: Sneaky Deckhand
cards.description: You may play me to an open battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "I like to think of her as a pre-boarding party." -Miss Fortune

cards.name: Stealthy Pursuer
cards.description: When a friendly unit moves from my location, I may be moved with it.
cards.flavor_text: "Anywhere you can go, I can go better."

cards.name: Undercover Agent
cards.description: DEATHKNELL - Discard 2, then draw 2. (When I die, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: Even he no longer knew which side he worked for.

cards.name: Acceptable Losses
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Each player kills one of their gear.
cards.flavor_text: "Never liked that sword anyway."

cards.name: Fading Memories
cards.description: Give a unit at a battlefield or a gear TEMPORARY. (Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before.)
cards.flavor_text: You too shall pass.

cards.name: Pack of Wonders
cards.description: Exhaust: Return another friendly gear, unit, or HIDDEN card to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor_text: "I know I put it in here somewhere...." -Teemo

cards.name: Scrapheap
cards.description: When this is played, discarded, or killed, draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: The parts that make it to the heap are the ones that DIDN'T blow up.

cards.name: Stacked Deck
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. Put 1 into your hand and recycle the rest.
cards.flavor_text: "Just lucky, I guess."

cards.name: The Syren
cards.description: 1, Exhaust: Move a friendly unit at a battlefield to your base.
cards.flavor_text: Without a ship, a pirate's just another common criminal.

cards.name: Traveling Merchant
cards.description: When I move, discard 1, then draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: Payment first, refund never.

cards.name: Treasure Trove
cards.description: When this leaves the board, draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: "We're gonna be rich!" -Common Last Words

cards.name: Whirlwind
cards.description: Starting with the next player, each player may return a unit to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor_text: "The storm approaches." -Janna

cards.name: Zaunite Bouncer
cards.description: When you play me, return another unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor_text: If he had things his way, NOBODY would get in.

cards.name: Kayn - Unleashed
cards.description:
GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

If I have moved twice this turn, I don't take damage.
cards.flavor_text: "I will survive eternity. They will die today."

cards.name: Kog'Maw - Caustic
cards.description: DEATHKNELL - Deal 4 to all units at my battlefield. (When I die, get the effect)
cards.flavor_text: "Oblivion come."

cards.name: Maddened Marauder
cards.description:
TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.)

When you play me, move a unit from a battlefield to its base.
cards.flavor_text: They know no fear. Nor much of anything else, really.

cards.name: Mindsplitter
cards.description: When you play me, choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. Choose a card from it, and they discard that card.
cards.flavor_text: Its victims go mad deciding which half to run from first.

cards.name: Miss Fortune - Buccaneer
cards.description:
You may play me to an open battlefield.

Friendly units may be played to open battlefields.
cards.flavor_text: "I always shoot first."

cards.name: Miss Fortune - Buccaneer (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
You may play me to an open battlefield.

Friendly units may be played to open battlefields.
cards.flavor_text: "I always shoot first."

cards.name: Nocturne - Horrifying
cards.description: GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.) When you look at cards from the top of your deck (and don't draw them) and see me, you may play me for [Power].

cards.name: Rhasa the Sunderer
cards.description: I cost 1 less for each card in your trash.
cards.flavor_text: It feeds well on death, but better on madness.

cards.name: Soulgorger
cards.description: When you play me, you may play a unit from your trash, ignoring its Energy cost. (You must still pay its Power cost.)

cards.name: Teemo - Scout
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

When you play me, give me +3 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Reporting in!"

cards.name: Teemo - Scout (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

When you play me, give me +3 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Reporting in!"

cards.name: The Harrowing
cards.description: Play a unit from your trash, ignoring its Energy cost. (You must still pay its Power cost.)

cards.name: Tideturner
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

When you play me, you may choose a friendly unit. Move me to its location and it to my original location.

cards.name: Twisted Fate - Gambler
cards.description:
When I attack, reveal the top rune of your rune deck, then recycle it. Do one of the following based on its domain:

Fury - Deal 2 to an enemy unit here and 1 to all other enemy units here.

Mind - Draw 1.

Order - Stun an enemy unit.

cards.name: Invert Timelines
cards.description: Each player discards their hand, then draws 4.
cards.flavor_text: "Good a time as any to act reckless." - Ekko

cards.name: Jinx - Rebel
cards.description: When you discard one or more cards, ready me and give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Rules are made to be broken. Like buildings! Or people!"

cards.name: Jinx - Rebel (Alternate Art)
cards.description: When you discard one or more cards, ready me and give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Rules are made to be broken. Like buildings! Or people!"

cards.name: Possession
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield. Take control of it and recall it. (Send it to your base. This isn't a move.)
cards.flavor_text: Some have a change of heart. Others need you to change it for them.

cards.name: Seal of Discord
cards.description: Exhaust: REACTION - ADD chaos. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

cards.name: Yasuo - Windrider
cards.description:
GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

The third time I move in a turn, you score 1 point.
cards.flavor_text: "I will follow this path until the end."

cards.name: Yasuo - Windrider (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

The third time I move in a turn, you score 1 point.
cards.flavor_text: "I will follow this path until the end."

cards.name: Back to Back
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Give two friendly units each +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Fight together or die alone.

cards.name: Call to Glory
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

As you play this, you may spend a buff as an additional cost. If you do, ignore this spell's cost.

Give a unit +3 Might this turn.

cards.name: Cruel Patron
cards.description: As an additional cost to play me, kill a friendly unit.
cards.flavor_text: Fealty is a duty, not a choice.

cards.name: Cull the Weak
cards.description: Each player kills one of their units.
cards.flavor_text: What good is having a plank if nobody ever walks it?

cards.name: Daring Poro
cards.description: ASSAULT (+1 Might while I'm an attacker.)
cards.flavor_text: Don't worry, they love it.

cards.name: Faithful Manufactor
cards.description: When you play me, play a 1 Might Recruit unit token here.
cards.flavor_text: Hard work is its own reward.

cards.name: Forge of the Future
cards.description:
When you play this, play a 1 Might Recruit unit token at your base.

Kill this: Recycle up to 4 cards from trashes.
cards.flavor_text: "What do you make? Beats me, but we do it better than anyone else."

cards.name: Hidden Blade
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Kill a unit at a battlefield. Its controller draws 2.
cards.flavor_text: Not every Noxian decree is read aloud.

cards.name: Petty Officer
cards.description: ASSAULT (+1 Might while I'm an attacker.)
cards.flavor_text: Cross him and you'll learn just how petty he can be.

cards.name: Soaring Scout
cards.description: DEATHKNELL - Channel 1 rune exhausted. (When I die, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: "Show us a path!" —Ashe

cards.name: Trifarian Gloryseeker
cards.description: LEGION When you play me, buff me. (If I don't have a buff, I get a +1 Might buff. Get the effect if you've played another card this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: War demands your life but offers immortality.

cards.name: Vanguard Captain
cards.description: LEGION - When you play me, play two 1 Might Recruit unit token here. (Get the effect if you've played another card this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: "Soldiers, to me!"

cards.name: Vanguard Sergeant
cards.flavor_text: He knew his orders: hold the line, or there would be nothing left to hold.

cards.name: Facebreaker
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Stun a friendly unit and an enemy unit at the same battlefield. (They don't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: "Play nice!" - Sett

cards.name: Imperial Decree
cards.description: ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) When any unit takes damage this turn, kill it.
cards.flavor_text: "With a word, I end you." -Azir

cards.name: Noxian Drummer
cards.description: When I move to a battlefield, play a 1 Might Recruit unit token here. (It is also at the battlefield.)
cards.flavor_text: Even the Legion's musicians are hard to beat.

cards.name: Peak Guardian
cards.description: When you play me, buff me. Then, if I am at a battlefield, buff all other friendly units there. (To buff a unit give it a +1 Might if it doesn't already have one.)
cards.flavor_text: Mount Targon's blessing is besowed upon those who have proven that they are strong enoguh without it.

cards.name: Salvage
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

You may kill a gear. Draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: One person's treasure is another one's trash.

cards.name: Solari Chief
cards.description: When you play me, choose an enemy unit. If it is stunned, kill it. Otherwise, stun it. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: The sun has many rays, each tasked with driving out the darkness.

cards.name: Spectral Matron
cards.description: When you play me, you may play a unit costing no more than 3 and no more than rune from your trash, ignoring its cost.
cards.flavor_text: "Come - there is use for you yet."

cards.name: Symbol of the Solari
cards.description: If a combat where you are the attacker ends in a tie, recall ALL units instead. (Send them to base. This isn't a move. Ties are calculated after combat damage is dealt.)
cards.flavor_text: "Next time, try to leave a dent!" -Leona

cards.name: Vanguard Helm
cards.description: When a buffed friendly unit dies, buff another friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 Might buff.)
cards.flavor_text: Vanguard soldier share both a helm and a vision.

cards.name: Vengeance
cards.description: Kill a unit.
cards.flavor_text: A brief moment of turmoil -- then peace.

cards.name: Albus Ferros
cards.description:
When you play me, spend any number of buffs.

For each buff spent, channel 1 rune exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: In Piltover, the best way to become a great inventor is to find a great investor.

cards.name: Commander Ledros
cards.description:
As you play me, you may kill any number of friendly units as an additional cost. Reduce my cost by order for each killed this way.

DEFLECT (Opponents must pay rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)

GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

cards.name: Fiora - Victorious
cards.description: While I'm MIGHTY, I have DEFLECT, GANKING and SHIELD. (I'm Mighty while I have 5+ Might.)
cards.flavor_text: "I long for a worthy opponent."

cards.name: Grand Strategem
cards.description:
ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Give friendly units +5 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: You need not understand the plan - only believe in it.

cards.name: Harnessed Dragon
cards.description: When you play me, kill an enemy unit.
cards.flavor_text: What bends a dragon's will is not strength, but sense of purpose.

cards.name: Karma - Channeler
cards.description:
VISION (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

When you recycle one or more cards, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 might buff. Runes aren't cards.)
cards.flavor_text: "Heart and mind as one."

cards.name: Karthus - Eternal
cards.description: Your DEATHKNELL trigger an additional time
cards.flavor_text: "We all have a place among the divine. We only have to accept it."

cards.name: King's Edict
cards.description: Starting with the next player, each other player chooses a unit you don't control that hasn't been chosen for this spell. Kill those units.
cards.flavor_text: Ruling is about making the hard choices. Serving is about living with the consequences.

cards.name: Leona - Determined
cards.description:
SHIELD (+1 Might while I'm a defender.)

When I attack, stun an enemy unit here.

(It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: "First light approaches."

cards.name: Leona - Determined (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
SHIELD (+1 Might while I'm a defender.)

When I attack, stun an enemy unit here.

(It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: "First light approaches."

cards.name: Machine Evangel
cards.description: DEATHKNELL - Play three 1 might Recruit unit tokens into your base. (When I die, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: The future is built by those who never see it.

cards.name: Sett - Kingpin
cards.description:
TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.)

I get +1 might for each buffed friendly unit at my battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Bein' the boss is a lot better than bein' the boss."

cards.name: Sett - Kingpin (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.)

I get +1 might for each buffed friendly unit at my battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Bein' the boss is a lot better than bein' the boss."

cards.name: Shen - Kinkou
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve, including to a battlefield you control.)

SHIELD 2 (+2 might while I'm a defender.)

TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
cards.flavor_text: "Tread carefully."

cards.name: Baited Hook
cards.description: 1 order exhaust: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may play a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
cards.flavor_text: There's always a bigger fish—sometimes a MUCH bigger fish.

cards.name: Darius - Executioner
cards.description:
LEGION - When you play me, ready me. (Get the effect if you've played another card this turn)

Other friendly units have +1 might here.
cards.flavor_text: "They will regret opposing me."

cards.name: Darius - Executioner (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
LEGION - When you play me, ready me. (Get the effect if you've played another card this turn)

Other friendly units have +1 might here.
cards.flavor_text: "They will regret opposing me."

cards.name: Divine Judgment
cards.description: Each player chooses 2 units, 2 gear, 2 runes, and 2 cards in their hands. Recycle the rest.
cards.flavor_text: Equality isn't always equal.

cards.name: Seal of Unity
cards.description: Exhaust: REACTION - ADD order. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

cards.name: Viktor - Leader
cards.description: When another non-Recruit unit you control dies, play a 1 might Recruit unit token into your base.
cards.flavor_text: "I am the first of many."

cards.name: Viktor - Leader (Alternate Art)
cards.description: When another non-Recruit unit you control dies, play a 1 might Recruit unit token into your base.
